extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create a Wikipedia article (new or unregistered editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance related to creating a new Wikipedia page (why a title may not exist and what to do next), aimed at contributors who want to create or locate an article on a given topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create a page; create an account and meet autoconfirmation requirements before creating an article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsure about creating a full article, use the article wizard to prepare a draft or follow the process to request a new article so experienced editors can assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy streaming industry" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, search Wikipedia to avoid duplication and to find existing coverage under alternate titles or spellings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate incoming links to see if the topic is covered elsewhere or if a redirect would be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporary invisibility / database delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page to appear but it does not, allow time for database updates or use the purge function before assuming it was not created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try alternative capitalizations and, if appropriate, create a redirect from common variants to the canonical article title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a title previously existed but is gone, consult the deletion log and relevant help pages to understand deletion reasons and whether recreation is appropriate.
